$comment: How ShinyQ HQ itself was built (owner request 2026-10-15). Knowledge for the Ask the HQ chatbot only: this file is not rendered; the long form is the /build page (content/build-story.json). It becomes one knowledge chunk (`site-build`) that is always retrieved for questions about this site (`isSiteQuestion` in functions/_lib/scope.ts), and an answer to such a question cites the /build page (`SITE_BUILD_PAGE` in src/ask/pack.ts), which links `source`, the public repository. Facts only, third person, verified against the repository; never a client company (C3), a cloud resource name, a hostname or a number that is not in the repository. Update it in the same PR when the stack, hosting, the assistant or the test gates change. Validated by SiteBuildSchema (src/content/schema.ts) and the public-safety lint.

text.en: How ShinyQ HQ, this site, was built: Kurniadi built it from October 2026, pull request by pull request, with AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot and Claude Code) implementing written design specs and per-feature plans; he reviewed and merged the work through pull requests that had to pass the required CI checks. It is a Next.js 16 static export with React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl for English and Indonesian, and content as zod-validated data. The 3D tower uses three.js through React Three Fiber with zustand for state; the device gets a full, lite or static tier, a Motion setting reduces animation, and the Classic site shows the same content as accessible HTML without WebGL. It runs on Cloudflare Pages, with Pages Functions for this assistant, performance beacons and visit stats, KV, Analytics Engine and the hq-stats Cron Worker. This assistant retrieves from a curated pack of the site's public content and answers with Gemma 4 on Workers AI through AI Gateway, falling back to Mistral Small 3.1, behind Turnstile, rate limits and output checks. Tests: Vitest, Playwright end-to-end shards, Lighthouse CI, and 3D gates on draw calls, triangles, JavaScript size and memory. The source code is public on GitHub as ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ. The full story (the architecture, the build rounds, the AI agent workflow, the quality gates and the numbers) is on this site's "How this site was built" page.
text.id: Cara ShinyQ HQ, situs ini, dibuat: Kurniadi membangunnya sejak Oktober 2026, pull request demi pull request, dengan AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot dan Claude Code) yang mengimplementasikan design spec tertulis dan rencana per fitur; ia me-review dan me-merge pekerjaannya lewat pull request yang harus lulus CI check wajib. Situs ini adalah static export Next.js 16 dengan React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl untuk bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia, serta konten berupa data yang divalidasi zod. Menara 3D memakai three.js lewat React Three Fiber dengan zustand untuk state; setiap perangkat mendapat tier full, lite, atau static, pengaturan Motion mengurangi animasi, dan Situs klasik menampilkan konten yang sama sebagai HTML yang aksesibel tanpa WebGL. Situs berjalan di Cloudflare Pages, dengan Pages Functions untuk asisten ini, beacon performa, dan statistik kunjungan, KV, Analytics Engine, serta Cron Worker hq-stats. Asisten ini mengambil konteks dari pack terkurasi berisi konten publik situs dan menjawab dengan Gemma 4 di Workers AI lewat AI Gateway, dengan fallback ke Mistral Small 3.1, di balik Turnstile, rate limit, dan output check. Pengujian: Vitest, shard end-to-end Playwright, Lighthouse CI, serta gate 3D untuk draw call, segitiga, ukuran JavaScript, dan memori. Kode sumbernya publik di GitHub sebagai ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ. Cerita lengkapnya (arsitektur, putaran pembangunan, alur kerja AI agent, quality gate, dan angka-angkanya) ada di halaman "Cara situs ini dibuat" di situs ini.
